name: claude-mods
description: A collection of small mods for Claude Code.

plugins.name: usage-bar
plugins.description: Compact one-line usage: current session and this week, each with percent, a bar and the reset time.

plugins.name: agents-panel
plugins.description: Side pane with the sessions, agents and subagents that are active or still have a warm prompt cache, each with what it did last; click a title to open it.
